outcome: Incidence of hypotension after spinal anesthesia
cohort: Pregnant women (n=84) undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: The incidence and magnitude of spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension was lower in severely preeclamptic parturients compared to normotensive parturients undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia, with no difference in fetal outcomes.
